verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਜਿ ਤਤ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਕਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: pa(n)j tat utapat kar gurmukh dharatee aap gavaiaa|

en.bdb: Cultivating the virtues of all the five elements in their hearts, the gurmukhs like earth have lost the sense of ego.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਸਭ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਭੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: charan kaval saranaagatee sabh nidhaan sabhe fal paiaa|

en.bdb: They have come to the shelter of the Guru's feet and from that store - house they get all sorts of benefits.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਕ ਵੇਦ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂੜਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: lok vedh gur giaan vich saadhoo dhooR jagat taraiaa|

en.bdb: From convention and the knowledge given by the Guru also the same (conclusion) emerges that the dust of the (feet of) sadh

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰਾਇਕੈ ਪਾਵਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: patit puneet karaikai paavan purakh pavitr karaiaa|

en.bdb: The fallen ones are made meritorious and the meritorious ones are further transformed into sacred ones.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣੋਦਕ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਮਿਤ ਸੇਖ ਸਹਸ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: charanodhak mahimaa amit sekh sahas mukh a(n)t na paiaa|

en.bdb: The glory of the wash nectar of the feet of sadhus is limitless; even Stesanag (thouosand hooded mythological snake) while

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੂੜੀ ਲੇਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਚਰਣੋਦਕ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿਗਤਿ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dhooRee lekh miTaiaa charanodhak man vasigat aaiaa|

en.bdb: Eulogizing the Lord by its many a mouth could not know it. The dust of sadhu's feet has erased all debts and because of that feet-wash nectar, the mind has also come under control.
Gurmukh first himself bowed at the feet and then he made the whole world fall at his feet.
